config.notes: Each ship retains its own fuel and hull. Purchased ships have an empty tank and intact base hull once. Migration retains all original shared fuel on the equipped ship, other owned ships receive0fuel and the previous shared damage points against each new base hull; no cash/cargo/equipment is removed. Fuel upgrade adds capacity only; hull upgrade adds structure points but does not repair earlier damage. Per-ship finite levels, existing purchase/cargo costs unchanged.
